description: Google's advertising platform API for creating and managing search, display, video, and shopping ad campaigns programmatically.
auth_method: OAuth2 + separate Developer Token per manager account
self_serve: admin/partner approval required - OAuth is self-serve but Developer Token needs Google approval for production access
api_surface: REST and gRPC, very broad; official read-only MCP server plus community MCP servers
blocker: Developer token approval gate for production/write access; official MCP is read-only

description: Meta's Marketing API for managing Facebook/Instagram ad campaigns, audiences, and creative.
self_serve: admin/partner approval required - own-account use self-serve, agency/third-party use needs App Review + Business Verification
api_surface: REST Graph API, broad; official Meta Ads MCP server (~29 tools) plus community servers
blocker: App Review + Business Verification for multi-tenant/agency use

description: LinkedIn's Marketing Developer Platform API for managing ad campaigns and audiences.
self_serve: admin/partner approval required - manual review with use-case description, often 4-8 weeks (up to 3-4 months)
api_surface: REST, moderate-broad; no official or notable community MCP server
blocker: lengthy manual partner-approval process gates all access

description: All-in-one CRM, funnel, and marketing automation platform for agencies and small businesses.
auth_method: OAuth2 (Marketplace apps) or Private Integration Tokens (internal use)
self_serve: self-serve trial - Private Integration Tokens self-generated in settings, no approval; OAuth marketplace apps self-registered
api_surface: REST, broad (contacts, opportunities, calendars, conversations, workflows); community MCP server (260+ tools), no official one
blocker: none significant; 24hr access token expiry needs refresh handling

description: Email and marketing automation platform for audience/list management, campaigns, and automation.
self_serve: self-serve free - free plan includes API access, key obtainable instantly
api_surface: REST, broad (lists, campaigns, automations, reports, e-commerce); no official MCP server confirmed
blocker: none significant; API keys are unscoped (all-or-nothing)

description: Marketing automation and email/SMS platform for e-commerce.
auth_method: Private API key (header-based) or OAuth2 (marketplace apps)
self_serve: self-serve free - private API keys self-generated instantly, OAuth app creation self-serve
api_surface: REST, broad (profiles, events, campaigns, flows, segments); official Klaviyo MCP server exists

description: All-in-one online business platform (funnels, email marketing, courses, affiliate programs).
self_serve: self-serve free - up to 3 public API keys self-generated, no approval
api_surface: REST, narrower surface (contacts, tags, subscriptions); no MCP server found
blocker: limited/narrow API surface (automations only indirectly triggerable)

description: Pinterest's API for managing organic content (pins, boards) and advertising campaigns.
self_serve: admin/partner approval required - apps must be approved for Trial access before tokens usable
api_surface: REST, broad (pins, boards, ad campaigns, analytics); no official MCP server confirmed
blocker: Trial access approval gate; test tokens expire in 24hrs during trial

description: Meta's Threads API for publishing posts and reading engagement/insights data.
auth_method: OAuth2 (short-lived tokens exchanged for 60-day long-lived tokens)
self_serve: self-serve trial with limitation - own-account use self-serve, broader use needs Meta App Review
api_surface: REST (graph.threads.net), moderate scope; no official or notable community MCP server
blocker: 60-day token refresh cycle; App Review needed beyond own account

description: Twilio's email sending and delivery platform.
auth_method: API key (Bearer token, also usable as SMTP password)
self_serve: self-serve free - free tier 100 emails/day, no card, key generated instantly
api_surface: REST v3, broad (mail send, templates, contacts, stats, webhooks); no official MCP, several community implementations
